classic_current.purpose: Measure common candidate foundation with both optional families off; compare with historical classic.

inventory.purpose: Measure inventory, dependent operations and context retrieval as one bundle against classic_current. No claim of isolated H01-H07 effects.

source_review.purpose: Measure primary TEXT handoff + source review + independent release check against classic_current. This is a method bundle, not isolated verifier attribution.

candidate.purpose: Combined arm requires accepted constituent methods; successful preflight is insufficient.

runtime_limits.terminal_filter: No general PE/N or repeated-number suppression accepted. AUDIT_OBJECT_TERMINAL_DISPOSITION means end-of-search disposition, not electrical terminal filtering.
runtime_limits.source_review: Current arm includes primary TEXT handoff plus source review and final check; treat this as a bundle.
runtime_limits.unresolved_context: Pending is not refuted; exclude missing-source removal from filter-success credit.
runtime_limits.report_section: F001/F030/F032 section disagreement remains explicit; independent factual/overclaim scoring continues. No expected answers supplied to executors.

dispatch_prerequisites: Export a fresh committed runtime snapshot; prior candidate snapshot predates current corrections.
Use current corrected six-project source package, not old unstarted layout inputs.
Freeze shared executor, variant configuration, evaluator, acceptance criteria and input hashes before new model calls.
Do not resume the stopped obsolete54-run series. Preserve its outputs as development evidence.
Run only separated methods until constituents pass; combination remains held.

remaining_owner.stage4: Resolve executable failures exposed by separate method tests; retain explicit unavailable/disputed source controls.
remaining_owner.stage5: Measure model quality and cost under the frozen configuration.
remaining_owner.stage6: Verify all retained clauses, unresolved obligations and questions through complete report issuance.
remaining_owner.stage7: Six-project regression plus independent new-project transfer.
remaining_owner.stage8: Production only after all acceptance and release gates.
